rules.title: Built-ins over UDFs
rules.text: Prefer built-in pyspark.sql.functions over Python UDFs. When a UDF is needed, use a pandas UDF with type hints.

rules.title: Do not collect big data
rules.text: Avoid collect() and toPandas() on large DataFrames. Aggregate or limit first.

rules.title: Assert with pyspark.testing
rules.text: Compare DataFrames and schemas in tests with assertDataFrameEqual and assertSchemaEqual.

rules.title: Broadcast small tables
rules.text: Hint joins with a small table using broadcast() and check the physical plan with explain().

rules.title: Explicit schemas
rules.text: Define schemas explicitly when reading files in production instead of relying on inference.

rules.title: Filter and project early
rules.text: Filter rows and select columns early to shrink shuffles, and avoid wide transformations you do not need.

rules.title: Adaptive execution
rules.text: Keep adaptive query execution enabled unless profiling shows a reason to change it.

rules.title: Cache sparingly
rules.text: Cache a DataFrame only when it is reused, and unpersist it when done.

rules.title: Assert on error classes
rules.text: Where the API exposes it, assert on the error class and message parameters instead of message text.
